scope: Numerical full-PW frozen-operator propagation of every original raw frame column with unchanged raw D; not physical band reduction or nonlinear evolution.
construction: Complete thin QR Psi=Q0 R, no starting-column selection. Retain R and initial residual. Reject singular/ill-conditioned R rather than clip original state. Seed HQ0=(retained H Psi) R^-1; no new seed action.

Twice reorthogonalize latest H block against entire accumulated basis; SVD numerical expansion deflation only. Store actual rejected expansion residual and singular values. Limited basis retains every initial column and all physical PW rows.

Store Q and HQ in bounded preallocated full-row arrays; T=Q*HQ is NOT Hermitized; E=HQ-QT remains full row. C=Q*Psi retains all original raw column coefficients. E and initial residual are retained for every evaluated stage.

For each requested signed t, approximate Psi(t)=Q exp(-itT) C. Reuse identical Q/HQ/T across times. Never form a PW-square matrix. Basis/action/memory bounds are explicit. Request every new H-column through the supplied callable, never unwrap a supplied atomic-counting wrapper. Seed reuse is separately recorded, not charged as fresh action.

derivation.identity: A=-i sign(t) H, B=-i sign(t) T, F=-i sign(t) E; e(tau)=exp(A tau)(Psi-QC)+integral_0^tau exp(A(tau-s)) F exp(Bs) C ds. This identity needs only T and E=HQ-QT; imperfect numerical orthogonality is diagnosed, not silently ignored.
derivation.growth: A supplied nonnegative g >= lambda_max((A+A*)/2) bounds the ambient semigroup. b=max(0,lambda_max((B+B*)/2)); projected anti-Hermitian content is retained. Both signs are covered by an ambient absolute anti-Hermitian norm bound. No assumption of exact Hermiticity.
derivation.analytic_envelope: Partition [0,tau] into cells [l,r], midpoint m, halfwidth d. Y=exp(Bm)C. Expand E exp(Bu)Y to degree p-1. Its integrated norm <= sum_j 2*d^(j+1)/(j+1)! * ||E B^j Y||F + 2*d^(p+1)/(p+1)! * ||E B^p||F ||Y||F exp(||(B+B*)/2||2*d). Multiply each cell by exp(g*(tau-l)); add exp(g*tau)||Psi-QC||F. Taylor integral remainder plus logarithmic norm for both signs proves this exact-arithmetic envelope. It is not a sampled numerical quadrature upper bound.
derivation.cheap_envelope: exp(max(g,b)*tau) * tau * ||E||F * ||C||F plus initial term is also an exact-arithmetic envelope; take min of independently valid envelopes.
derivation.qualification: Computed envelopes use ordinary floating-point QR/actions/expm/norm/eigenvalues: diagnostics/estimates of exact-arithmetic bounds, NOT floating-point interval certificates. Seed solve error and action roundoff are separately diagnosed; no rigorous rounding enclosure is claimed. Missing target stays insufficient.

oracle.execution: Independent proof must pass before actual material run; no tests or scientific execution by implementation worker.

material.optional_comparison: Explicit settled full-PW SciPy receipt and digest plus retained array binding; never auto-discover pending results. Authenticate exact frame/D/stage inputs and time before comparison.
material.receipts: Publish evaluated stage, all requested times, retained arrays, physical density/Gram invariants without refilling, residuals, action columns, timing and RSS before any next expansion.
material.storage: Large arrays under explicit array-root outside Git; retained input action memory mapped without copying to new storage.
